text:
Maria: FYI — after the route-weight rollout at ~09:10 UTC we observed a short spike in sub-second reconnects from EU clients on both SSE and WS. Console shows a lot of route_flip events and duplicate billing markers.
Raj: I see it too — p95 reconnect latency ~350ms but request count jumped ~3x for 6m. Which rollout id?
Oliver: traces indicate clients bouncing between route-id-12 -> route-id-19 -> route-id-12 quickly. Sampling masks the pattern unless you look at contiguous session traces.
Jen: was there any change to the proxy 204/empty-body handling? last time that caused rebinds.
Maria: not 204 this time; proxy returned 200 keepalive, but the route balancer recalculation interval was shortened to 10s and affinity decay is aggressive.
Kevin: short decay means sticky lease is lost and resume tokens sometimes land on a backend without the session kv. That probably causes resume to fall back to new-session billing.
Matt: are resume_token validations failing, or are they accepted but we still treat it as new for billing dedupe?
Oliver: mixed. about half the resume attempts returned 202 Accepted and resumed, the other half routed to a path that treats it as new session (billing increment).
Raj: our console aggregates by route_id and then session count; we currently don't stitch session_id across route swaps so it looks like two separate sessions in billing.
Jen: short-term visibility fix: add a transient console tag that links session_id across route flips (trace.parent_session) so SRE can see merged sessions.
Maria: +1. Short-term mitigation: rolling back the affinity decay from 10s -> 60s via feature flag. Deploy-bot: kicking a config rollback (canary 5%).
deploy-bot: rollback started: feature.route_affinity_decay set to 60s (canary 5%).
Kevin: after rollback can we run a quick replay on the last hour of traces and produce a diff report: merged-sessions vs baseline? Need that for billing ops.
Matt: also let's log explicit proxy-side resume_token rejection reasons (missing header, token mismatch, KV not found) — small change to the proxy.
Oliver: long-term items: 1) surface cross-route session stitching in console UX, 2) make billing dedupe depend on resume-accept status, 3) change trace sampling to ensure at least one complete session trace survives route flips.
Raj: filing quick tickets: ENGPLAT-1198 (console session stitching tag), ENGPLAT-1199 (proxy resume rejection logging).
Maria: deploy-bot reports canary moved to 30% and reconnect counts are down ~55%. Monitoring for 20m.
Jen: adding a streaming dashboard alert: if route_flip_count / active_prefix_sessions > 0.08 for 5m, fire a P0 channel.
Kevin: if rollback fully stabilizes, plan controlled rollout with decay=45s and the new telemetry flags enabled.
Maria: TL;DR — rollback in flight, short-term fix = increase affinity window; follow-ups for console telemetry + proxy logs created. :thumbsup:
